per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

free_tier.stated: Models ending in -free are priced at $0 and never touch the wallet; they are limited by per-minute and per-day request ceilings and, on the lowest tier, a per-request prompt-size cap, with an established GitHub account required to avoid an access-denied rejection.

chaining: the per-request prompt cap and the GitHub link gate bind before the rate windows

limits.value: -free ids have rpm/rpd windows and a per-request prompt cap on the lowest tier; numbers published live at GET /api/free-package/public

identity_cost.detail: an established GitHub account linked to the workspace owner is required unless lifetime spend exempts it

reliability_note: free ids never fall back to paid and the lineup rotates as capacity allows

evidence.proved: the -free tier serves models at $0 under a suffix, limited by request windows and a prompt cap
